name: Pixel Clawd
description: Seven pixel Clawd sprites. Use one as the working indicator — it walks and plays with its prop while a turn runs, and waves when it waits on you — and any as an add-on button's icon.

zh.name: 像素 Clawd
zh.description: 7 个像素小螃蟹 Clawd 素材：可以当对话运行时的 loading（跑的时候走路、摆弄道具，等你确认时停下来挥爪子），也可以当插件按钮的图标，每处用不同的造型。
